Because the funds required are so overwhelmingly large, he pledges false fealty to King Salo and his trusted minister in exchange for performing clandestine missions at the king's behest. His efficiency at achieving results eventually wins him and his former subordinates free citizen status, although some of his underlings lose their lives in the meantime.

If Judar overcomes the betrayal and the royal forces who were aware of Eutre's betrayal, he is forced to fight alongside Judar for the duration until Lilica and Judar figure out a suitable punishment.
